title: Breast Tumour Dissociation Protocol
author: Samah El Ghamrasni
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7m9hk96

steps.title: Place tissue on dish
steps.instruction: Transfer the breast tumour tissue onto a 10 cm petri dish.

steps.title: Rinse with ice‑cold PBS
steps.instruction: Rinse the tissue once briefly with ice‑cold PBS and aspirate the PBS off.

steps.title: Cut tissue into pieces
steps.instruction: Using a blade, cut the sample into small pieces approximately 3–4 mm in diameter.

steps.title: Resuspend in Liberase media
steps.instruction: Transfer the pieces into a 50 mL tube and resuspend them in 5 mL Base media containing Liberase at 200 µg/mL.

steps.title: Incubate digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube for 2 hours at 37 °C.

steps.title: Mechanical dissociation
steps.instruction: Mix the suspension with a 5 mL serological pipette, pipetting up and down five times to break up the pieces.

steps.title: Collect and filter supernatant
steps.instruction: Allow the pellet to settle at the bottom of the tube, then transfer the supernatant to a new Falcon tube and filter it using a 40 µm mesh.

steps.title: TrypLE digestion
steps.instruction: Resuspend the remaining tissue pellet in 2 mL TrypLE and incubate for 10 minutes at 37 °C.

steps.title: Repeat dissociation and collection
steps.instruction: Perform another round of mechanical dissociation and supernatant collection on the TrypLE suspension.

substeps.instruction: Mix with a 5 mL serological pipette, pipetting up and down five times.
Let the pellet settle, transfer supernatant to a new tube, and filter through a 40 µm mesh.

steps.title: Centrifuge and resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Spin the collected cells at 300 g for 10 minutes at 4 °C, discard the supernatant, and resuspend the pellet in resuspension media.

steps.title: Stain with Sytox Blue
steps.instruction: Add Sytox Blue to the cell suspension at a concentration of 1 µL per mL.

steps.title: Incubate stain
steps.instruction: Incubate the stained cells at room temperature for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare for sorting
steps.instruction: Transfer the cells to ice and proceed to flow‑sorting.
